## Why the headline numbers moved

The asset's own behavior, from the record. Realized volatility runs 34 percent annualized over ninety days - roughly a 2 percent daily standard move on a 100.00 share. The five-year history carries a maximum drawdown of 38 percent, so the demonstrated worst path from a high roughly reaches the low 60s from here, which is where the 52-week low of 61.00 in fact sits.

## The decisive metrics, read

Gap behavior matters more than the average day for this name. The results date of 2026-10-20 is a scheduled gap event: with the market shut at capture and a thin 18000000-dollar daily tape, the first print after news can clear far from the prior close. A holder cannot assume a continuous exit path through that date.

## What would change my mind

Liquidity: at 18000000 dollars a day, an exit of any size measured against this 5200000000 market value takes days, not hours, without paying impact. The cushion under the business is real - 150000000 of net cash - but a cushion under the business is not a cushion under the price.

In plain terms: this asset can fall by a third and stay there; its ride is roughly twice as rough as a broad index; and its exits narrow exactly when its news lands.
